trimmed_dict.title: Sips & Stories: Home is Not a Country
trimmed_dict.description:
About: 

The Sips & Stories book club meets once a month on the 3rd Tuesday of the month at 4:00pm. Each meeting we will discuss the chosen book and enjoy a tea pairing that goes along with the book.

Sips & Stories: Home is Not a Country | 4pm | Library

Tea Pairing: TBD

In 1954 San Francisco, Lily Hu discovers her identity and first love with Kathleen Miller at the Telegraph Club. Amid Red Scare paranoia and threats to her immigrant family, Lily must navigate cultural expectations, political danger, and personal truth, risking everything to embrace love in a world determined to keep her silent.

Come join the discussion to broaden your reading horizons, learn about new teas, and meet new people.
